text: Admission requirements 1. Applicants should be over 18 years of age 2. Applicants should hold a high school diploma or equivalent to that of a Chinese high school graduate 3. HSK level 6 or above 4. Recommendation from at least two teachers with titles of associate professor or above 5. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 6. Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and the regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits. 7. Be in good health
